hero.subtitle: Hello, I'm Flavio, but you can call me Limão. I build multi-agent systems and knowledge bases around one fixed idea: AI that gives autonomy back to people.

story.title: Where my personal brand began
story.stamp: made of who i am · not just code ·
paragraphs: As a kid, I had a friend everyone called "Alemão" (German). I thought it was so cool — being known not just by your name, but by something more. Something that stood for who you were.

I knew it would never make sense for people to call me German. But I loved lemon popsicles, so I thought: "why not Limão (Lemon)?" I tried it. It did not stick. I asked for it. It got worse. That is not how nicknames work.

Decades later, I decided to do things differently. On my first website, I told this story around the idea that "when life gives you lemons...". It was the first time I let my personality show without a filter, and gave meaning to that childhood story — because being different always mattered to me.

That website is what led a company — with the ambition of going AI first, right at the start of the GPT-3.5 era — to find me. They expected to hire an AI engineer. They found someone who insisted on thinking differently.
That is when Limão finally stopped being just an attempt at a nickname and became an identity.
story.punchline: In the end, they did not just hire an AI engineer. They hired Limão.
story.quote: There is no technology without a product, and no product without people. When people are free to be themselves, they deliver what only they could build.

roles.summary: Helping build a fintech's AI practice from the ground up.
bullets: Design and ship multi-agent systems and evaluation harnesses across the company's products.
Build the knowledge bases that ground product and support decisions.
Set the responsible-AI practices, measured by outcomes, quality, and the autonomy they hand back to the team.

roles.summary: Joined at month three, when customer support was still 100% human.
bullets: Introduced AI as a layer that backed the human team instead of replacing it.
Built the multi-agent architecture that carried support through the company's growth.
This is where "Limão" actually stuck, earned by the work rather than by the story.

roles.summary: The data team's utility player, across dozens of different domains.
bullets: Shipped short-cycle deep learning projects in wildly different contexts, back to back.
Moved into AI agent work back in the GPT-3.5 era and decided right there that this was the specialty worth committing to.

roles.summary: Internship and undergraduate research while completing a degree in Engineering Physics.
bullets: Worked on applied research at one of Brazil's leading science and technology centers.
Came close to an academic career and chose a different path: I wanted what I build to reach people's hands, sooner.
